answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks when every identity must climb a reputation summit one verified job at a time: each task earns a signed receipt hash-linked to the last, and independent peers audit the chain like a lantern held over the ledger, exposing any forged link. New accounts must lock a refundable stake in a sable escrow vault before trading, and one forged receipt slashes the deposit. A thousand fake identities cost a thousand deposits and a thousand verified jobs, so forgery pays less than honest work.
